caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden workbench with a flat top surface made of several horizontal planks. The bench has four sturdy square legs, with additional horizontal support beams connecting the legs near the top and bottom. A lower shelf, also composed of wooden planks, runs the full length of the bench between the side supports. The wood is illustrated using light to medium brown tones, showing visible grain and texture. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or features present. There is a small signature in the bottom right area of the image that reads "R.K. MILLER." The composition centers the bench in the middle of the image, with a slight shadow cast on the left side and underneath the bench, indicating a light source from the top right.
